verdict.rationale: Docusaurus is fundamentally a static-site generator that turns a directory of Markdown/MDX files (the standard git-repo docs-as-code model) into a built site via `npm run build`, and the scaffold/versioning CLI operates directly on the `docs` folder in your repo; a community user explicitly describes migrating an existing 'markdown docs-as-code' setup to Docusaurus. Missing for 10: explicit first-party guidance on git branch/PR workflows, review-then-merge publishing pipelines, or built-in CI/CD integration tied to git events (deployment is left to generic 'npm run build' + your own hosting/CI).
